newsitem.title: LATVIA: C.BANK SAYS BUYS LATS AS STILL UNDERVALUED.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK SAYS BUYS LATS AS STILL UNDERVALUED.

text.p: The central bank said on Wednesday that the lat was still undervalued and in May it bought 20 million lats of foreign currency to prevent the lat from rising.

"The central bank still acts as a buyer and as a seller of foreign currency.. yet another indirect sign of the lat being below its real value," Einars Repshe, the central bank governor told a news conference.
The central bank at the end of May bought a significant amount of dollars, freeing the market from an excess of foreign currency, Repshe said.
"Under a freely floating rate, this would otherwise have led to a rise in the lat, had not the central bank exercised its stabilising function, " Repshe said.
